name: suede-graph-flo-xr
description: Suede AI multi-file shipping workflow (Suede Thought Graph shipping search) for one repo change: generates competing implementation plans, scores and prunes them, refutes the survivors, aggregates compatible lanes, selects one winner, then builds it in an isolated worktree behind a sandboxed gate and writes a handoff file. Use when competing implementation plans need one evidence-gated selection before any build. Halts on hazards, collisions, budget exhaustion, or no safe winner. Reads productio
author: JasonColapietro
